turns.question: What was the median site session duration in minutes between 20 September and 3 October 2026?
turns.answer: The semantic layer has no metric for median site session duration, so I can't give a figure for 20 September to 3 October 2026. The closest metrics are Site sessions (sessions with a page view, counted on the day of the page view) and Cart sessions and Checkout sessions, which count sessions by step rather than by duration.
